text.text: Claims
What each tool's authors claim, the result that would disprove each claim, and where it stands. Only kmerseek has filed claims so far.
Data from 16 Oct 2026, commit 31c41258 (source)
The build recomputes every verdict from the tables or checks it against the recorded notebook output, so nothing on a card is typed in by hand.
kmerseek
